facts.fact: Angola's national directorate for telecommunications and IT (Matias Borges) announced two new government data centres in Luanda (Camama and a modernised backup at the Centro Nacional de Dados, Rangel) to migrate existing and new government applications to a unified government cloud, a national cloud costing the State USD 89 million.

systems.platform: Camama main data centre (204 server cabinets) and Rangel backup data centre
systems.tiers: three levels: organs of sovereignty, State administration, information society
